```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Load the project's functions from the checkout (decision 0042) and read the
# published data bundle, so this code reproduces the figure (decision 0040).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
release <- data_release_date()
```

```{r}
#| label: figure
# Only seasons the data has finished count, so the season still being played
# does not pull a group's median down.
complete_through <- last_complete_cfb_season()
pos <- signature_positions(collect(tbl(con, "roster")))
sa <- collect(tbl(con, "player_stats")) |>
  build_season_arcs()
values <- sa |>
  filter(season <= complete_through) |>
  signature_season_values(pos)
arcs <- median_arcs(values, min_players = 50L)

p <- ggplot(arcs, aes(season_index, med, colour = group, fill = group)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = q1, ymax = q3), alpha = 0.12, colour = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point_interactive(
    aes(
      tooltip = paste0(
        group,
        ", career season ",
        season_index,
        ": median ",
        fmt(med),
        " yards across ",
        fmt(players),
        " players"
      )
    ),
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_colour_position(guide = "none") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = position_palette(), guide = "none") +
  facet_wrap(~group, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "Does yardage grow over a career?",
    subtitle = "Median signature yards by career season, in seasons where every group has at least fifty players",
    x = "Career season",
    y = "Median signature yards",
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card()

card_thumbnail(p, "yardage-across-career", release = release)
card_interactive(p)
```

```{r}
#| label: population-table
# Who the arcs are built from: players and their seasons and games in the
# complete seasons only.
pg <- collect(tbl(con, "player_game")) |>
  filter(season <= complete_through)
games <- signature_game_values(build_game_production(pg), pos)
values |>
  count(group, name = "season_lines") |>
  left_join(
    values |>
      group_by(group) |>
      summarise(players = n_distinct(playerId), .groups = "drop"),
    by = "group"
  ) |>
  left_join(count(games, group, name = "game_lines"), by = "group") |>
  transmute(
    `Position group` = group,
    Players = fmt(players),
    `Season lines` = fmt(season_lines),
    `Game lines` = fmt(game_lines)
  ) |>
  knitr::kable(
    col.names = c("Position group", "Players", "Season lines", "Game lines"),
    caption = paste0(
      "Players, season lines and game lines behind each position group, over the seasons through ",
      complete_through,
      "."
    )
  )
```
